profile.title: Profile Settings
profile.description: Manage your personal bot preferences below.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.help: Used when you type natural-language times (e.g. "Saturday 8pm"). Unix timestamps are always absolute. Natural-language parsing is English-centric.
timezone.failedOpen: ❌ Could not open the timezone form.

language.name: Language
language.help: Overrides the server language for your DMs and ephemeral replies. Public channel posts always use the server language.

patrolDm.name: Patrol completion DMs
patrolDm.on: ✅ **Enabled** - you receive a DM when a patrol session completes.

joinReminders.name: Patrol join reminders
joinReminders.on: ✅ **Enabled** - you may be DM'd when joining patrol without the Shield Member role.

eventStatus.name: Event status updates
eventStatus.on: ✅ **Enabled** - you receive DMs when your planned events are submitted, approved, denied, or cancelled.

modReasonPing.name: Moderation reason pings
modReasonPing.on: ✅ **Enabled** - you get pinged in mod logs when a reason is missing.
modReasonPing.off: ❌ **Disabled** - you will not be pinged; you are responsible for providing reasons yourself.
modReasonPing.disableWarning: ⚠️ By disabling mod reason pings, **you become responsible** for providing reasons for your own moderating actions. Failure to do so may result in punishment by higher staff.

memberCard.name: Public member card
memberCard.on: ✅ **Enabled** - other members can see your verified MAIN VRChat account, patrol hours this month, and whether you are on leave (end date only, never the reason).
memberCard.off: ❌ **Disabled** - `/user lookup` shows only your Discord identity to others. You can still preview the full card yourself.

profile.footer: Event scheduling rules (Monday ban, weekly limits) always use EST.
